== Description ==
'''M-22i''' is the 1st and only '''Prime''' (no, the other I variants aren't primes, they are supers) within [[Section M]]

== Mechanic ==
'''M-22i''' will have a chance of spawning after [[M-22]]'s attack. It will rush to the current room silently at fast speeds and not emitting any sound cue. When '''M-22i''' is close enough, it will fill all player's screen with static. Once '''M-22i''' make its way to the door, it will break it down and fallback and despawn.

== Strategy & Tips ==
If you see any sudden static appearing during M section, immediately hide regardless of if there's other entities active.

== Trivia ==
* '''M-22i''' does not have a reliable far ambience like [[M-22]].
* '''M-22i''' is a failed experiment from the S.P.A.W.N agency to make a better version of [[M-22]]
* [https://youtu.be/w_18sZCIezQ?si=7YIimhJCyUIEl458 Update Executive Teaser 6]
